items.question: What work does the Calder & Wynne engagement cover?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter does not specify the exact scope of work covered in the engagement. The documents only mention that the engagement is a "Letter of Engagement" and include clauses related to termination and liability [1].
